verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a password manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers and calls their tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-consuming agent capability, and its CLI is for retrieving secrets, not for consuming external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
